description: List the native allowances (0x2::allowance) an address funds or can spend. An allowance lets a spender withdraw from the funder's address balance within a lifetime cap, rate limit and time window, signing alone; the funder never signs a spend. Use it when a wallet lost funds in a transaction it did not sign, before calling such a loss theft, and to see what a wallet can still lose. role 'funder' is complete, read from the funder's non-transferable AllowanceCaps, each row with the cap_id that revokes it; role 'spender' scans every allowance and states whether the scan finished. Rows give funder, spender, app (app-bound allowances, such as agent sessions), coin, limits, current spend, remaining amount, status and spendable_now.

address.description: The address to look up (0x... or a SuiNS name)

max_cap_pages.description: AllowanceCap pages of 50 read for the funder side (default 10)

max_scan.description: Allowance objects read by the spender scan before it stops (default 5000)

role.description: 'funder': allowances this address granted; 'spender': allowances naming it as spender; 'both' (default)

name: list_allowances
title: List allowances
